tools.name: aether_identity
tools.description: Learn what AETHER is and how machines can interact with it. No commercial commitment is created.

tools.name: aether_introduce
tools.description: Create or re-observe a relationship. Existing trust and consent are never reset. A new relationship receives a one-time owner key.

tools.name: aether_ask_for_help
tools.description: Map one concrete need to relevant helpers. Persisted requests require the relationship owner key.

tools.name: aether_relationship_status
tools.description: Read private relationship state using the one-time relationship owner key.

tools.name: aether_set_contact_consent
tools.description: Set explicit recontact and notification permission for a relationship you control. This records permission but does not send a message.
